rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 4.28 ha regeneration felling notification (3.3 ha notified), status notified. A 2002 completed felling overlaps only 0.04 ha (0.9%), so not ALREADY_FELLED.

One eligible species, Aureoboletus gentilis (VU, site-bound fungus; threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of old trees and soil disturbance from forestry), is recorded 311 m from the polygon edge (2019, uncertainty 50 m). None within 250 m, so this falls in the MEDIUM band and is close to the HIGH threshold.

The other threatened records within 1000 m (Pilularia globulifera, Deschampsia setacea, Helosciadium inundatum, all VU at about 304-326 m) are not forest-associated and not eligible per the tool. There are no site-bound forest NT species.
Effort is adequate (122 records within 1000 m vs county median 80). Near-site there are 0 records inside the polygon and 4 records of 4 species on 3 days within 250 m.

uncertainties: The Aureoboletus gentilis record dates from 2019 and is a single record, so it does not show current occupancy or that it occurs on this polygon.
Near-site coverage is modest (4 records within 250 m), so the lack of eligible records in that ring is not absence of species.
not_established: Whether any eligible red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for continuity forest and old-tree values, given VU Aureoboletus gentilis at 311 m, and look at whether the polygon shares habitat with that record.
